title: Framework Core Abstraction
description: Extract render-independent shared primitives and runtime shell into @framework/core; platform and playground product cores specialize it; fix framework/product workspace wiring.
summary: Created @framework/core with JsonValue, declarative primitives, layout/toolbar/command routing, BaseWindowKindRuntime/BaseModeRuntime/BaseAppRuntime, Platform shell, createBodyRegistry, and vitest coverage. Refactored @framework/platform/core to re-export core and extend runtime for capabilities/surfaces/plugins. Refactored @framework/playground/core to re-export core, extend WindowKindRuntime with engagement, and import canvas builders from platform. Fixed root workspaces, package paths, script.ts repo imports, vitest aliases, removed React deps from playground core, regenerated @framework symlinks. All three core test suites pass. Renderer vitest configs updated for framework/product depth (puzzle/ui/platform aliases); platform renderer 7 tests and playground renderer 9 tests pass.
